+def test_identically_named_nested_module(initialized_linter: PyLinter) -> None:
+    """Test that pylint works when a module has the same name as its parent directory.
+    
+    Regression test for https://github.com/PyCQA/pylint/issues/...
+    When we have a directory structure like:
+    .
+    `-- a/
+        |-- a.py
+        `-- b.py
+    
+    Running pylint on the directory should work without requiring __init__.py
+    """
+    linter = initialized_linter
+    with tempdir():
+        create_files(["a/a.py", "a/b.py"])
+        linter.check(["a"])
+    assert not linter.stats.by_msg
